articles.title: Japan’s SBI, SMFG launch Solana venture for stablecoins, tokenization
articles.snippet: SBI Solana Global plans to develop stablecoin payment infrastructure, explore AI agent micropayments and tokenize financial assets.

articles.title: French Senate rejects 100K euro crypto wallet disclosure requirement
articles.snippet: Senators also rejected stablecoin-swap and crypto exit-tax proposals, while the 2027 budget remains under parliamentary consideration.

articles.title: Stablecoin redemptions hit $12B in 30 days, echoing 2022 bear market
articles.snippet: Crypto research firm Kaiko said the cash-out was smaller than in 2022 and has slowed, with stablecoin supply down just 0.4% since Nov. 13.

articles.title: South Korea’s crypto bill could move stablecoin race beyond token issuance
articles.snippet: South Korea’s draft bill favors bank-led stablecoin issuance but allows fintech and technology companies to become the largest individual shareholders.

articles.title: BlackRock launches tokenized money market fund accepting stablecoins in Hong Kong
articles.snippet: The tokenized fund launched with approximately $100 million in assets, with Standard Chartered and Ant International participating as seed investors.
